ache.title: “HUGE announcement!” Ache’s eyebrow: raised
ache.note: Nero calls this Zenless Zone Zero team announcement HUGE and wants to talk about it together. News like this is built to keep you excited between patches, so the game never leaves your head. Being curious is fine. Just notice when every reveal makes you start counting your currency.
watch: news that starts a pull plan
ache.tip: Read the news, then close it. You can react when it actually arrives, not weeks early.
lines: all caps doesn’t mean all in
he was SO loud. calm down, Nero
